coefficient_metric: RF products counts EACH Fraction multiply AND divide, including normalization; not interchangeable with historical nonconstant-polynomial products

rational.multiply: two Poly products, then Rational normalization
rational.add: zero/equal-denominator comparisons must be charged; otherwise three Poly products and one Poly sum, then normalization
rational.partial: two Poly partials, three Poly products and one subtraction, then normalization
rational.normalize: at most one Fraction reciprocal plus term_count(N)+term_count(D) Fraction scales; height at most h_N+h_D and 2*h_D respectively; constant denominator case included

element16.multiply: at most256 basis pairs; each one Rational product plus up to4 curve-factor Rational products; retain all mask xor accumulation/constructor costs
element16.inverse: supported only one y-basis component: at most4 curve-factor Rational products then reciprocal; arbitrary multicomponent inverse is unresolved/unsupported
element16.V: for each at most16 components: one Rational.partial, one y-basis product and optional c*(3*x_i^2-1)/2 term; aggregate all moving-y derivative contributions

exact_final_division.precondition: complete rational is Laurent after whole source/weight assembly; no support shortcut before exact remainder check
exact_final_division.degree_control: For denominator coordinate degree D, choose lex weights (D+1)^3,(D+1)^2,D+1,1. Every divisor tail is strictly lower weighted degree than its lex lead. Starting weighted numerator bound K controls every intermediate exponent.
exact_final_division.iteration_upper: product_i(floor(K/w_i)+1), since each leading monomial strictly decreases lex in that finite box
exact_final_division.per_iteration: one leading Fraction division when divisible, at most denominator_terms coefficient multiplications, full negate/add constructors and quotient/remainder updates; all work/quotient/remainder/temporary buffers coexist before release
exact_final_division.must_bind_to_actual_source: nonzero denominator and Laurent/divisibility theorem plus degree/height bounds for the final actual numerator and denominator are still required

storage: RF uses Python Fraction/dict/list/tuple, not AC packed-integer layout; interpreter/object/alias lifetimes need a separate authenticated byte metric and schedule
